steps.description: Enter the **Orphanage**, then **save** your game on the right. When you're ready, try to go through the western door to trigger a scene and a sub-boss battle.

notes.title: Note
notes.text:
- If **Yuri** doesn't have his level 2 **Fire** and **Water** Fusions yet, I recommend taking the time fighting the **Banshees** and **Larmgelgs** here to get them.
- Having the **Fire Fusion** will help immensely in the upcoming boss battles.
- You may want to equip **Pocket Watches** while fighting the **Larmgelgs**.

boss.name: Night Stalker
boss.strategy:
- There's not much to worry about with this guy; other than boosting himself up, his physical attacks do a decent amount of damage, but that's it.
- Have **Alice** whoever is attacked.
- Have **Yuri** fuse into **Ifrit**, using **Ignition** to boost his attack power, then start wailing on the **Night Stalker** with physical attacks.
- Have **Halley** constantly use his **Strong Earth** attack, which should do pretty decent damage to the wind-based enemy.
- Have **Alice** keep everyone healed, using **Blessed Light** when she's not healing.

steps.description:
1. After taking him out, open the door to the left for a scene, where you'll receive the **Guestroom Key**.
2. Check near the bed in the lower-left corner to find a **Seal of Luck**, then check behind the bed on the left in the middle for a **Pure Extract**.
3. Finally, check between the two beds at the top of the screen for a **Monkey Paw**.
4. Once you have everything, go back out into the hallway.

1. Head up the stairs, then go right and down to find an **Eye of Ouroboros**.
2. Now make your way to the left side of the room, then down to find a **Zodiac Bracelet**.
3. Next, head into the room against the upper wall, on the left side.
4. Examine the books on the table in here to do a **Normal Ring** that spins **really** fast, which will allow you to see the following date: 5, March, 75, so remember "5375" for later.
5. Check the floor in front of the fireplace for a **Lottery Ticket**, then feel free to read the diary on the desk at the bottom of the screen if you like.
6. Leave the room.

1. Go over to the door on the right upstairs, and it'll ask for a password, so enter "5375" from the picture's date to unlock the door.
2. Check in front of the fireplace in this room to find some **Monk Earrings**, then check the desk above the fireplace for another **Normal Ring**.
3. After completing it, read the master's diary to find out what's really been going on around here, then examine the painting to the right of the desk, showing it was done on the following date: 3 July, 54, so remember "3754" for the next password.
4. Leave this room, then **save your game**.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: The next boss uses **Paralysis**, and the one after that uses **Petrification**, so make sure each party member is wearing either a **Zodiac Bracelet** or a **Crucifix** to prevent both.

steps.description: When you're ready, examine the northern door in the center and input "3754", then go inside. Watch the events unfold, and you'll have to take on **Jack** himself.

items.text: **Jack** will mainly just use his **Paralysis** attack against you, though you should be guarded by a **Zodiac Bracelet** or a **Crucifix**.
He will also use pretty strong physical attacks, and his **Slash** attack, which will do MAJOR damage to one party member, so make sure to stay healed.
He will use **Thera Seeds** when his HP starts to drop.
When fighting, keep in mind that you have a harder boss battle right after this, with no chance to heal.
Have **Yuri** fuse into **Ifrit** and use his **Ignition** to boost his attack, then have him attack as normal.
Have **Halley** cast **Strong Earth** continuously (not **Aqua Blade**, since **Jack** is water based) for the whole battle, unless he's learned **Air Shot** by now, then by all means, use that.
**Alice** should be healing as needed, using **Blessed Light** when no healing is needed.
If you're comfortable at the end, take a turn or two to make sure everyone is healed to the max and ready for the next battle.

steps.description: Without getting a chance to breathe, you'll be thrown into an even harder boss battle.

items.text: **Mammon**'s normal attacks will hit for pretty decent damage, but its biggest threat is its **Petrification** attack, which hopefully you've prevented with either a **Zodiac Bracelet** or a **Crucifix**, though it'll still do a decent amount of damage, even if you did.
It will also use a **Shockwave** spell, doing quite a bit a damage to your entire party, as well as **Needlerain**, a strong attack to just one party member.
Its **Howling** skill will replenish its HP by 500+ once it's near dying, but lucky for you, **Yuri**'s a powerhouse and will take that away and then some in one round.
As usual, have **Yuri** fuse into **Ifrit** and use his **Ignition** to boost his attack, then have him attack as normal.

Have **Halley** use his **Air Edge** on **Yuri** to increase **Yuri**'s damage output, then have him cast **Aqua Blade** for the remainder of the battle, unless he's learned **Air Shot** by now, then by all means, use that.
**Alice** should be healing as needed, using **Blessed Light** when no healing is needed.

steps.description: After the battle, you'll watch a quick scene, then you'll be back at the **London Rats**' hideout. After a few more events, you'll regain control.

1. Make your way all the way downstairs, saving if you wish.
2. Talk to little **Joshua** down here, who will ask **Halley** if he can have his slingshot.
3. Answer with [1] Sure. don't need it.

notes.title: Make sure to choose 1
notes.text: **Make sure to choose** 1! If you choose 2, you'll miss out on getting a better weapon for **Halley** later on.

steps.description:
- There's one more item to be had at the **Orphanage**, so leave **Old Castle Street** and go back to the **Orphanage** one last time.
- Go into the center room where you fought **Jack** and check behind the wire grating on the right; you'll find the **Draze**, a better gun for **Margarete**.
That's it for events within the **London** city limits for now, so head back out to the Britain section of the **World Map**, then make your way to the **Calios Mental Hospital**.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: As before, I recommend bringing **Alice** with you, mainly because the main boss the next boss is a Dark class. You can change your party with **Meiyuan** on **Old Castle Street** to whomever you want, if you wish.
